_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Zero of 72 12h windows have produced a ±2 score move in 7 days — this is a textbook coil where forced directional calls have gone 0-for-14, making HOLD with conviction the skilled, statistically grounded position.
next_move.brains_agree: Both agree on Anxiety phase and coil framing, but split on confidence and analog reliability — analyst distrusts the match while narrative trusts it
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed drops below 22 with btc_momentum_30d breaking below 35 and stablecoin_growth reversing positive — signals Capitulation/Panic leg down
next_move.invalidated_if: etf_flows break above 60 with btc_momentum_30d clearing 55 and funding cooling below 45 — signals Disbelief/Hope leg up; or any 12h score move exceeding ±2 points breaking the coil
